hack.root_cause: Empty market accumulator inflation via flash loan donation mechanism + rounding error → collateral inflation → drain
hack.description: zkLend lost $9.57M on Starknet when an attacker combined three harmless-looking design details — an empty market, a flash loan donation mechanism, and integer rounding — to inflate their collateral balance from 1 to over 7,000 wstETH and drain multiple lending pools.
